notes: 1. 来源与题量：本卷是 2025-10-25 笔译复赛真题（docx，非扫描件），卷内两道语篇翻译题，顺序为「汉译英：」（绿色消费，中文 3 段）在前、「英译汉：」（发展中国家企业创造就业，英文 4 段）在后；articles 按卷内顺序收录这两篇。已剔除卷头与题号行（“汉译英：”“英译汉：”）；卷内没有术语填空、选词填空、完形填空这类非语篇题，也没有答题框与评分标准行。2. 无参考译文：该 docx 只有原文，卷内不含任何答案或参考译文，故 answerFile 为空字符串、两篇的 reference 都是空串——按规矩不自行翻译。3. 订正一（中文篇，2 处）：(a)“推动缘色发展”→“推动绿色发展”（依据：同段与相邻段落一律作“绿色”——“绿色发展目标”“绿色消费”“低碳”，“缘色”不成词，系抽取错字）；(b) 第 2 段末尾“消费体系初步形成.”的半角句点→全角“。”（依据：全篇其余句末都是全角句号；并且该段逐字对应《促进绿色消费实施方案》（2022 年 1 月由七部门印发）公布的绿色消费目标，公开文本此处作“……绿色低碳循环发展的消费体系初步形成。”，见 https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1722558445875938 ）。4. 订正二（英文篇，共 41 处替换，分布在 4 段：8/16/11/6 处）：这个 docx 的英文正文是 PDF 转出来的，丢字母与丢空格是系统性损伤，逐处订正如下，补出的词都可由上下文唯一确定，未改写任何语句、未增删任何内容——(a) 丢字母/并字母 10 处：ldentifying→Identifying（段首大写 I 被抽成小写 l）；frms→firms；generaly→generally；fourish→flourish（fl 连字里的 l 被吃掉）；well-conected→well-connected；acelerate→accelerate；supliers→suppliers；skils→skills；polices→policies；potentialy→potentially。(b) 词间空格丢失 10 处：tomorrow'sworkforce、jobs andbetter、thegreatest、adisproportionate、andtheir、makesustained、thecreation、fortrade、networksand、accessto 各补一个空格。(c) 句读后空格丢失 23 处：逗号、冒号、分号、句号之后一律补回一个空格（英文排版常规），例如 evidence:a→evidence: a、hire,where,and→hire, where, and、economies.While→economies. While。(d) 破折号被抽成连字符 1 处：technology parks-can→technology parks—can（依据：同一段前文 clustering of economic activity—in 用的就是 U+2014 破折号）。注：上述四类按“现象”统计，合计 44 处，比替换数 41 多 3，因为有几处替换一改就修了两样（丢字母＋丢空格，或词间空格＋句读后空格）。5. 存疑未改（英文第 4 段，1 处，不计入上面的处数）：“place-based clustering of economic activity—in special economic zones, industrial clusters, and in special economic zones, industrial clusters, and science and technology parks—can amplify…”里“in special economic zones, industrial clusters, and”重复出现了两次，两处排版还不一致（前一处 clusters,and 无空格、后一处 clusters, and 有空格）。这不是单字层面的抽取错字，删掉等于动正文，故照录未改，只补了空格、还原了破折号。该篇材料出自世界银行／IFC 2025 年 7 月报告“Which Firms Create More and Better Jobs?”（见 IFC 播客页 https://www.ifc.org/en/podcasts/audio-stories/2025/which-firms-create-the-most-jobs ），但本次没能拿到报告正文逐字核对，无法确认这段重复是原卷如此还是转换产生；若确认是重复，应删去前一处“in special economic zones, industrial clusters, and”。另一处存疑（英文第 2 段，未改）：该段列举五个主题时分隔符混用冒号与分号——“evidence: … new jobs: … size; … locations: … suppliers; …”，其中 new jobs 与 locations 之后读起来像分号之误（同一串里其余并列项用的是分号）。分不清是原卷写法还是转换所致，照录未改。6. 引号与撇号照录未统一：英文篇用的是直双引号与直撇号（tomorrow's、world's），与 2025-may 等卷的弯引号写法不同，系原文件如此，未作统一（沿用 2023-past-paper.json 的先例）。7. 段数：汉译英原文 3 段、英译汉原文 4 段；两篇都没有参考译文，因此不存在原文与译文段数对齐的问题。8. 话题判定：汉译英那篇讲绿色消费与《促进绿色消费实施方案》的绿色低碳目标（落到碳达峰碳中和），按“这篇材料讲的是什么”归入“生态”而不是“经济”；英译汉那篇讲发展中国家哪些企业能创造就业、以及配套的登记许可、监管与融资政策，归入“经济”。

articles.summary: 绿色消费兴起与政策推进
articles.text:
开新能源车、淘二手好物、选小份菜……这届年轻人，正在爱上绿色消费。网络调查显示，年轻消费者更愿意为可持续品牌和产品买单，超半数受访者表示会在二手平台消费。这既是以实际行动践行环保理念，也包含着“可以买贵的，不能买贵了”的理性和务实。

《促进绿色消费实施方案》提出多个绿色发展目标：到2025年，绿色消费理念深入人心，奢侈浪费得到有效遏制，绿色低碳产品市场占有率大幅提升，重点领域消费绿色转型取得明显成效，绿色消费方式得到普遍推行，绿色低碳循环发展的消费体系初步形成。

商务部相关负责人表示，推动绿色发展、促进绿色消费，对于实现碳达峰碳中和目标、构建新发展格局以及推动高质量发展都具有深远的意义，将通过举办系列活动，大力推进绿色消费，并致力于提升消费者参与度，进一步激发绿色消费潜力。

articles.summary: 发展中国家企业创造就业的条件
articles.text:
Identifying which firms hire, where, and why is essential for delivering opportunity to tomorrow's workforce in developing economies. While predicting which firms will create the most jobs and better jobs is challenging, research provides valuable insights on the attributes of firms with the greatest employment potential.

Five themes consistently surface from the evidence: a small number of firms account for a disproportionate share of new jobs: the most dynamic employers tend to be relatively young, and their chances of success are generally unrelated to initial size; businesses tend to flourish in well-connected locations: they accelerate when plugged into value chains, multinationals, or sophisticated suppliers; stronger management skills and technology adoption underpin their success. These facts together point to practical, actionable ways of channeling private capital into large-scale employment, underscoring a potentially strategic role for policies to support firms.

Complementary analytical tools, such as screening algorithms or sector diagnostics, are needed to identify firms whose business models, market positioning, and managerial depth make sustained employment growth more plausible. At the policy level, streamlined registration and licensing procedures can improve allocative efficiency by lowering entry barriers for productive young firms. Moreover, a conducive business environment with a broad set of regulations encompassing labor, tax, property rights, standards, trade, foreign direct investment, contracts, and industrial and competition policies that support allocation of resources to the most able firms can go a long way in their hiring expansion. Targeted regulatory interventions that involve the creation of new regulatory structures or incentives for equity financing and new platforms for trade and finance, or those that lower the risk for angel investors, can be instrumental for private sector job creation.

Job creation can also be enabled when firms are incentivized to connect to production networks and improve managerial and technological capabilities at scale. Investments that widen access to supply-chain financing and trade-finance facilities enable constrained suppliers to integrate into global value chains and to exploit export demand. Analogous to business networks, place-based clustering of economic activity—in special economic zones, industrial clusters, and in special economic zones, industrial clusters, and science and technology parks—can amplify job creation effects when paired with efficient land-use regimes and high-quality physical and digital infrastructure.
